title: Seahawks OC Brian Fleury wants to maintain as much of Klint Kubiak's offense as possible

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks OC Brian Fleury wants to maintain as much of Klint Kubiak's offense as possible
sources.description: Brian Fleury is getting his first chance to be an NFL offensive coordinator this season, but he isn't planning to make radical changes to the Seahawks offense.
